351.name: measured_leaf

275.name: MeasureInput
275.docs: What a measured leaf is asked.

350.name: compute
350.docs: Computes the layout of `root` inside `available` logical pixels.

274.name: available_height
274.docs: Vertical space offered by the parent.

173.name: spacing
173.docs: Gap between consecutive children, in logical pixels.

349.name: node
349.docs: Adds a container (or a fixed-size leaf) with the given children.

273.name: available_width
273.docs: Horizontal space offered by the parent.

172.name: axis
172.docs: Stack direction, or `None` for a leaf.

348.name: clear
348.docs: Removes every node, keeping allocations for the next build.

96.name: Align
96.docs: Cross-axis alignment of a stack's children.

272.name: known_height
272.docs: Height already fixed by the parent, if any.

347.name: new

95.name: Fit
95.docs:
As `align_self`: keep its own size. It follows a parent that centers or
ends its children, and goes to the start of one that stretches them.
This is what a button wants, so it never grows to a column's width.

271.name: known_width
271.docs: Dimensions already fixed by the parent.

346.name: LayoutTree
346.docs: A layout tree whose measured leaves carry a context `C`.

194.name: leaf
194.docs: A leaf box with no children and default sizing.

93.name: End
93.docs: Align to the trailing edge of the cross axis.

193.name: stack
193.docs: A stack along `axis` with default spacing, padding and alignment.

344.name: fit
344.docs: Nodes whose `align_self` is [`Align::Fit`], until their parent is known.

91.name: Start
91.docs: Align to the leading edge of the cross axis.

190.name: LayoutStyle
190.docs: The box model a widget asks for. `axis: None` makes a leaf.

189.name: absolute
189.docs:
Takes the box out of the flow and places it at this `(x, y)` offset
from its parent's top-left corner (design surfaces, diagrams, canvases).

188.name: aspect_ratio
188.docs: Width divided by height; with one dimension known, the other follows.

238.name: limit
238.docs: The width to wrap at, if any.

36.name: into
36.docs: Calls `U::from(self)`. That is, this conversion is whatever the implementation of [From]<T> for U chooses to do.

187.name: wrap
187.docs: Children move to a new line when they do not fit (flex-wrap).

136.name: Justify
136.docs: Main-axis distribution of a stack's children.

186.name: grid_columns
186.docs: Lays children out in this many equal-width grid columns instead of a stack.

135.name: SpaceBetween
135.docs: Put free space evenly between children, none at the ends.

185.name: overflow_hidden
185.docs:
Content may overflow this box (it scrolls or clips): the box does not
grow to fit its content.

235.name: Available
235.docs: Space offered to a measured leaf along one axis.

134.name: End
134.docs: Pack children at the end of the main axis.

184.name: align_self
184.docs: Overrides the parent's cross-axis alignment for this box.

234.name: MaxContent
234.docs: Lay out without constraints (e.g. never wrap).

133.name: Center
133.docs: Center children on the main axis.

309.name: LayoutError
309.docs: A failure reported by the underlying Taffy tree, e.g. an unknown node id.

183.name: grow
183.docs: Share of free main-axis space this box takes inside its parent stack.

359.name: node_count
359.docs: Total number of nodes in the tree.

233.name: MinContent
233.docs: Lay out as narrow as possible (e.g. wrap at every opportunity).

384.name: ravenrs_layout
384.docs:
Layout for RavenRS, built on [Taffy](https://github.com/DioxusLabs/taffy).

Widgets describe boxes with [`LayoutStyle`] (a deliberately small subset of
flexbox: stacks, gaps, padding, alignment, sizes and growth). Leaves that size
themselves, such as text, carry a context `C` and are measured through a
callback, so this crate does not depend on the text engine.

132.name: Start
132.docs: Pack children at the start of the main axis.

358.name: context_mut
358.docs: Mutable access to a measured leaf's context, or `None` for nodes without one.

232.name: Definite
232.docs: A definite number of logical pixels.

357.name: content_size
357.docs: The size of the node's content, which can exceed its frame when it overflows.

4.name: Axis
4.docs: Direction in which a stack places its children.

356.name: content_box
356.docs: The content box (frame minus padding) relative to the node's own origin.

179.name: height
179.docs: Fixed height in logical pixels; `None` sizes to content.

178.name: width
178.docs: Fixed width in logical pixels; `None` sizes to content.

354.name: frame
354.docs: The node's frame relative to its parent's origin.
